name: Zhejiang NHU Company Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang NHU Company Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells nutritional products, fragrances and flavors, polymer materials, and active pharmaceutical ingredients in China and internationally. It operates through Pharmaceutical and Chemical; and Other segments.
